shots.name: wn-airless-night
script: const ps = G.state().planets; const P = ps.find((p) => p.kind === 'moon') ?? ps.find((p) => p.kind === 'barren');
await G.camera({ mode: 'orbit', planet: P.id, lat: 5, lon: 40, dist: P.radius * 2.8, hour: 22 }); return { id: P.id, name: P.name, kind: P.kind, r: P.radius };

shots.name: wn-airless-ground-night
script: const ps = G.state().planets; const P = ps.find((p) => p.kind === 'barren') ?? ps.find((p) => p.kind === 'moon');
await G.camera({ mode: 'surface', planet: P.id, lat: 10, lon: 30, alt: 25, pitch: 4, hour: 23 }); return { id: P.id, name: P.name, kind: P.kind };
